deals.title: Happy Hour
deals.summary: 1/2 off cocktails, beer & wine; sliders and shareable fries
deals.evidence:
Happy Hour:M-Th, 3-6PM
Looking for the best happy hour in Dallas? Hopdoddy hosts the happiest of them all with 1/2 off cocktails, beer & wine Monday through Thursday from 3-6PM.

notes: Applies to the McKinney Ave location. The chain-wide happy hour page says cocktails, beer, wine & sliders are 1/2 off Mon-Thu 3-6pm. An 'Austin' banner says M-F 3-6PM dine-in only, but it is Austin-specific, so it was not used. No location-specific text was found for the Luther Ln location.
